connectorUiConfig.title: Major.build Invocations
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The **[Major.build](https://major.build) Invocations** connector ingests AI agent invocation logs from the Major.build platform into Microsoft Sentinel. Each record captures which user triggered an invocation, which application and resource integration was used, and the full request payload — including API paths called or SQL queries executed by AI agents.

The connector supports multiple Major.build accounts in one workspace. Each connection is added independently, labeled by account name, and listed in the connections grid. Use this data to monitor user activity, detect anomalous AI-driven API patterns, audit database queries executed by agents, and correlate automation activity with your broader security posture.

sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize InvocationCount = count() by accountName
| sort by InvocationCount desc

{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize InvocationCount = count() by userEmail, userName, accountName
| sort by InvocationCount desc

sampleQueries.description: Database queries executed by AI agents
sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and payloadType == 'database'
| project TimeGenerated, accountName, userEmail, applicationName, resourceName, payload['sql']
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

sampleQueries.description: Top API paths called by AI agents
sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and payloadType == 'api'
| summarize Count = count() by accountName, tostring(payload.method), tostring(payload.path)
| sort by Count desc

dataTypes.name: {{graphQueriesTableName}}
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where TimeGenerated > ago(12h)
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

customs.name: Major.build API key
customs.description: A valid API key from each Major.build account is required. Keys begin with **MJR_** and can be generated from Major.build platform settings. Connect one key per account.

parameters.content:
#### Prerequisites

- One or more Major.build accounts with API access enabled
- An API key for each account you want to connect. Keys begin with `MJR_`.

#### Get an API key

1. Sign in to the **[Major.build platform](https://major.build)**
2. Go to **Settings → API Keys**
3. Generate a new key or copy an existing one
4. Copy the full value (it starts with `MJR_`)

> Keep each key secure. Anyone with a key can query that account's invocation history, including SQL text and API paths executed by AI agents.

After the solution is installed, use **Add connection** to connect each Major.build account. Connecting a second account does not overwrite the first.
